The '''Skyholme Astromancers''' was an informal group of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitives]] that lived among the people of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] deep in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that was long disconnected from the [[The galaxy/Legends|civilized galaxy]].

==History==
A group of antisocial [[Witch/Legends|wizards]] that formed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], the Astromancers were fiercely territorial and lived as hermits in small villas or towers where they presided over their arcane texts and studies. They lived far afield of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Skyholme/Legends|Skyholme]], but met there in conclave during the annual [[Star/Legends|solar]] eclipse. Looking to the stars and other astral bodies to divine the future, they used chalk circles, fetishes, and incantations as they drew on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; these tools were simply focusing the energy, as their understanding of the Force was limited. Distrustful of each other, the group was highly disorganized and insular. A small sect of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark siders]], known as [[Skyholme Lucites|Lucites]], formed from among the Astromancers and grew to be reviled and hunted by their light side cousins.<ref name="NoP" />
